BrochureContent.Content:
Property Team Paul Reddy is proud to present to the market 51 Glen Ellan Green, a superb four-bedroom semi-detached family home ideally positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac within the ever-popular Glen Ellan development, overlooking a spacious green area. Extending to approximately c. 131 sq. m., this beautifully presented residence offers bright, spacious, and versatile accommodation, perfectly suited to modern family living. Additional features include double-glazed windows throughout and gas-fired central heating, ensuring year-round comfort and efficiency.
Upon entering, you are greeted by a warm and inviting interior with generous living space throughout. The home boasts four well-proportioned bedrooms and three bathrooms, providing ample room for growing families. At the heart of the property is a modern upgraded kitchen, thoughtfully designed to accommodate both everyday living and entertaining. A separate family room to the side adds valuable flexibility and can serve as a second reception room, playroom, home office, or TV room. The property further benefits from excellent potential to extend to the side and rear, subject to the appropriate planning permission.

Outside, the property continues to impress with a cobble lock driveway to the front, providing excellent off-street parking. To the rear, the home enjoys a private south-facing garden, a wonderful sun-filled space ideal for relaxing, outdoor dining, and family enjoyment throughout the day. A large shed with power offers additional storage or workspace potential.
Located in a mature and highly desirable residential setting, this exceptional home is within easy reach of Swords Main Street, excellent schools, shops, parks, and transport links, making it a perfect choice for families seeking both comfort and convenience.

Note: Please note we have not tested any apparatus, fixtures, fittings, or services. Interested parties must undertake their own investigation into the working order of these items. All measurements are approximate, and photographs are provided for guidance only.
